_README: Host evidence template for the attendance Windows-native exact-SHA QA v2 matrix. In the reworked flow the route-less HARNESSES write most of these cases automatically (status + reason + evidence + the safety fields they can attest) into <evidence-dir>/summary.json; the operator affirms the Windows-only host facts and fills the HTTP/UI cases. The qa-runner validates SAFETY + SHA binding + an evidence contract that FAILS CLOSED on missing/malformed evidence and on a wrong/stale SHA; it raises the evidence floor (a per-case reason + evidence above a trivial token) but is NOT a proof of authenticity — the runner reads this operator-written JSON, so a determined operator can still write a plausible evidence string. It never judges product correctness. Ships every case status=BLOCKED with empty reason/evidence and unaffirmed safety fields on purpose: a straight copy without doing the work reports BLOCKED, never PASS.

_fill_instructions.closed_set: cases[] must be EXACTLY the ten matrix ids PQA-01..PQA-10 — no missing, no extra, no DUPLICATE ids. The runner rejects any violation.
_fill_instructions.sourceSha: Leave as the pinned SHA; must equal the package SOURCE_SHA (0dc3596dd...). qa-runner BLOCKS any mismatch or stale SHA. May be top-level and/or per-case.
_fill_instructions.residue: Set to the number returned by residue-check.sql AFTER drop/recreate teardown. PASS requires 0. Leave null until measured. (Top-level, single global measurement.)
_fill_instructions.per_case_safety_fields: PER-CASE ONLY (no top-level fallback): isolatedDatabase=true, databaseName=metasheet_windows_qa, hostPlatform=windows, windowsPowerShellVersion=5.1.x, customerOrExternalDestination=false, externalNotificationsSent=false. A shared top-level affirmation no longer covers any case.
_fill_instructions.cases[].status: PASS | FAIL | BLOCKED. Start BLOCKED. Set PASS only when observed==expected for every step, that case's residue is 0, AND a non-empty per-case reason + evidence are present. Set FAIL on any product deviation.
_fill_instructions.cases[].reason: Non-empty per-case evidence note; REQUIRED for PASS (whitespace-only is rejected).
_fill_instructions.cases[].evidence: Non-empty per-case step output / SQL result / file reference; REQUIRED for PASS (whitespace-only is rejected). The harnesses fill this from real execution.
_fill_instructions.cases[].syntheticDataOnly: Per-case affirmation that only synthetic orgs/users/shifts/punches were used. PASS requires true.
